title: pilosella iserana
intro: Pilosella iserana, commonly known as Iseran's mouse-ear or Pilosella iserana, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb that grows in the alpine regions of the European Alps. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and digestive problems, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella iserana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects.
